subject: fix alignment different between c and c++ in gtest (#3331)
reason: The change rewrites _Atomic declarations in server.h from the qualifier form (_Atomic T) to the type-specifier form (_Atomic(T)), which are semantically identical in C, so the server binary's behavior is unchanged. The substantive edit is to src/unit/wrappers.h, a header used only when compiling the C++ gtest unit tests, where the _Atomic macro now preserves alignment via alignas instead of being defined away. This is a test/build infrastructure fix with no runtime behavior to exercise: a fuzzer scenario against a running server cannot reach it, and a compared sequence would show no difference
